mass_reduction.name: Mass Reduction
mass_reduction.description: Reduces the mass of your rocket, allowing for faster acceleration and higher top speed.

fuel_efficiency.name: Fuel Efficiency
fuel_efficiency.description: Improves the fuel efficiency of your rocket, allowing you to travel further on the same amount of fuel.

fuel_weight.name: Fuel Weight
fuel_weight.description: Reduces the weight of your fuel, allowing you to carry more fuel without increasing the mass of your rocket.

fuel_capacity.name: Fuel Capacity
fuel_capacity.description: Increases the fuel capacity of your rocket, allowing you to carry more fuel and travel further.
